bagPolicy.summary: FivePoint Amphitheatre does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at FivePoint Amphitheatre offers General Admission and Preferred options. Advance online purchase costs $10 for GA and $20 for Preferred on Thursdays, while onsite and online purchases on the day of the event are $15 for GA and $25 for Preferred. Additional fees may apply.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in FivePoint Amphitheatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at FivePoint Amphitheatre varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available for those with mobility disabilities who require accomodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: No, after exiting Great Park Live, re-entry is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at FivePoint Amphitheatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at FivePoint Amphitheatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
